summary: A 1936 steel tower near Big Springs Ranger Station on the Targhee NF; its cabin was removed in 1989, and the abandoned tower was registered in 2015.

facts.design: Steel tower with a small 7 by 7 foot cab, built by the Aermotor Company of Chicago
facts.status_note: Abandoned; only the tower remains after the cabin, garage and latrine were removed in 1989

access.note: Listed as a hike-in on Idaho Fire Lookouts. The register records no signed directions. No closure or permit requirement appears in the pages read, but no source says whether the tower may be climbed.

visit.trail_note: Hike-in per Idaho Fire Lookouts. A 1949 account describes walking a mile from the bus at the foot of the hill; current directions are not signed per the register.

events.note: Steel tower reportedly built by the Civilian Conservation Corps; the site also had a one-room log cabin, a single-car garage and a latrine. Sources differ on height: 72 feet (Island Park Historical Society) or 100 feet (Idaho Fire Lookouts, firelookout.com).
Group of female Forest Service employees visited; some climbed the 70-foot tower to look for smoke
One of only three lookout towers on the Targhee National Forest
No longer used; replaced by aircraft patrols
Idaho Fire Lookouts gives 1985. The Island Park Historical Society says the lookout was no longer used by 1981.
The Forest removed the cabin, garage and latrine; only the tower remains
Register visit report by Byron Nelson (July 11, 2006) answered Yes to Good condition? and Yes to Needs paint?

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Island Park Historical Society gives a 72-foot tower and a 1949 account says 70 feet. Idaho Fire Lookouts and firelookout.com give 100 feet. The 72-foot figure is used here because it comes with the most detailed description; 21.9 m is that height converted.

Idaho Fire Lookouts dates abandonment to 1985. Island Park Historical Society says the lookout was no longer used by 1981, replaced by aircraft patrols. The record keeps 1985 as the abandonment event and adds 1981 as a use-ending event.
The register gives 6,856 ft (2,090 m). Idaho Fire Lookouts and firelookout.com give 6845 ft. The register figure is the one used in the brief's elevation_m.

notes_for_editor: Height is disputed: 72 ft (Island Park Historical Society, 2026) against 100 ft (Idaho Fire Lookouts, firelookout.com). Abandonment is 1985 on Idaho Fire Lookouts but no longer used by 1981 per Island Park Historical Society. The staffing as_of 1981 is the last date sources give for use. The register page is undated, so its staffed=No answer is not used as a date. No photo with a stable URL was found. A Forest Service social-media post and an Instagram repost describe the 72-foot tower, but their text could not be read, so they are not cited. Access is hike-in per Idaho Fire Lookouts; the record does not say whether the abandoned tower may be climbed, so check with the Targhee NF before publishing any visit advice.
